description: This file defines data classes and database entities related to repositories in the FDroid app, including CoreRepository, Repository, Mirror, AntiFeature, Category, ReleaseChannel, and RepositoryPreferences, along with utility functions for conversion and validation.

classes.name: CoreRepository
classes.description: Data class representing the core repository information stored in the database.

classes.name: Repository
classes.description: Public class representing a repository with related data such as mirrors, categories, and preferences.

classes.name: Mirror
classes.description: Entity class representing a repository mirror with associated data.

classes.name: AntiFeature
classes.description: Entity class representing an anti-feature attribute of a repository.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Entity class representing a category of apps within a repository.

classes.name: ReleaseChannel
classes.description: Entity class representing a release channel for apps in a repository.

classes.name: RepositoryPreferences
classes.description: Entity class storing user preferences and metadata for a repository.

classes.name: InitialRepository
classes.description: Data class used to pre-populate the database with minimal repository info.

classes.name: NewRepository
classes.description: Data class used to add new repositories.

methods.name: RepoV2.toCoreRepository
methods.description: Converts a RepoV2 object to a CoreRepository data class.

methods.name: getFingerprint
methods.description: Calculates the fingerprint of a certificate string.

methods.name: validateCertificate
methods.description: Validates the format of a certificate string.
